definitions.gloss: kaki-no-tane; small crescent-shaped soy-sauce rice cracker
definitions.explanation: A snack of small curved orange rice crackers flavored with soy sauce and a touch of chili, named for their resemblance to persimmon seeds. Usually sold mixed with peanuts and eaten with beer.

examples.english: A colleague who went to Niigata brought me wasabi-flavored kaki-no-tane as a souvenir.

notes:
Literally "persimmon seed," from the shape of the cracker. The snack originated in Niigata in the 1920s and is now a supermarket staple; the literal meaning is rarely intended in modern speech.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {柿|かき}ピー: kaki-no-tane mixed with peanuts (the usual abbreviation)
- わさび⟦{味|あじ}→味：00826_aji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{柿|かき}の{種|たね}: wasabi-flavored kaki-no-tane
- {柿|かき}の{種|たね}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つまむ→つまむ：10374_tsumamu⟧: to nibble on kaki-no-tane

SIMILAR WORDS:
- せんべい: rice cracker — the broad category; {柿|かき}の{種|たね} is one specific product shape
- おかき: rice cracker made from glutinous rice — closer in texture, but larger and usually plain
